title: Specialised Transportation of Seniors to Care Centres
what_it_is: Specialised Transportation of Seniors to Care Centres

sections.label: Transport subsidies for subsidised clients
sections.summary: The Government provides transport subsidies for subsidised clients needing mobility assistance, with grants for wheelchair-friendly vans or appointed AIC transport operators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government provides transport subsidies for subsidised clients who require mobility assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: New centres can apply for a one-time grant to defray the costs of purchasing a wheelchair-friendly van.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Alternatively, centres may engage the appointed transport operators under the AIC centralised transport service to send seniors to and from the centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, AIC has engaged ComfortDelgro to provide scheduled transport services for centre clients.

sections.label: Transport capacity meets current demand
sections.summary: Multiple transport options provide adequate capacity for current demand, with spare capacity as the centralised service can ramp up specialised vans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Based on our landscape scan, there are multiple transport options for centres which I have already elaborated on during my Parliament Question reply and that are assessed to be able to provide adequate transport capacity to meet our current demand.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We have continually grown the capacity of specialised vans to meet the demand over the years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: My short answer is, we are able to meet the demand based on the current supply.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In fact, we have some spare capacity, taking into account that our centralised transport service can ramp up the number of specialised vans to be made available.
